point_in_time_solana.design: point-in-time: 300 bonding-curve swaps ending at graduation ("curve_end") the first 300 PumpSwap AMM swaps after graduation ("amm_start") and the first 300 AMM swaps starting 1h after graduation ("amm_1h"), from the free pump.fun swap API (same data as on-chain swaps: wallet, side, SOL, token amount); outcome (cohort) measured afterwards

cohorts.died: research DB: now <=10% of peak and liquidity <$10k or mcap <$50k, or RugCheck rugged, or never >2x and <$10k mcap after 3 days (crash/rug)

point_in_time_solana.caveat: Many died tokens peak within ~1h of launch, so part of the amm_start window can fall after their peak (see died_window_after_peak_mean_share); curve_end is always pre-graduation.

composite_policy.note: Backtest support: curve_end score>=60 (high): crash/rug OR 30.68 (p=0.0001); curve_end score>=35 (elevated+): crash/rug OR 49.0 (p=0.0); curve_end fake_share>=30%: crash/rug OR 6.38 (p=0.0022); curve_end round_trip_share>=10%: crash/rug OR 6.44 (p=0.0069); curve_end any wallet ring: crash/rug OR 6.39 (p=0.0002); curve_end top5 wallets>=50% of volume: crash/rug OR 25.83 (p=0.0); amm_start score>=60 (high): crash/rug OR 22.67 (p=0.0007); amm_start score>=35 (elevated+): crash/rug OR 35.87 (p=0.0); amm_start fake_share>=30%: crash/rug OR 17.96 (p=0.0); amm_start round_trip_share>=10%: crash/rug OR 17.29 (p=0.0); amm_start top5 wallets>=50% of volume: crash/rug OR 3.49 (p=0.0006); amm_1h fake_share>=30%: crash/rug OR 5.0 (p=0.0007); amm_1h top5 wallets>=50% of volume: crash/rug OR 12.36 (p=0.0)
composite_policy.short: Backtest (pump.fun, measured before the outcome): score>=35 at graduation flagged 62/96 crash/rug vs 2/51 runners (OR 35.87); bonding-curve end 73/86 vs 2/24 (OR 49.0). On mature catalog tokens the CURRENT score does not separate crashed from runners (AUC 0.444), so it is a young-token signal.

catalog_cross_section.design: cross-sectional, CURRENT trades (GeckoTerminal last <=300 swaps + Jupiter organic) vs catalog state; association only, not a forecast (fake volume measured after the crash/run)

cohorts.crashed: catalog token now <=-80% from confirmed peak
